metadata.name: lodz_vault
metadata.description: LODZ vault: Adit onboarding, Seam registry, Stope vaults, Orecart redemption queue, keeper bond and slash

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Accept a pending authority handover.

instructions.name: accrue_yield
docs: Book realized yield against one seam.
The reporting keeper transfers `amount` of the seam's asset into
custody; the program attributes it to that seam's declared
[`state::YieldKind`] and to no other. Requires an active bond, and refuses
once an emissions seam's declared schedule has ended.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The reporter's bond. `active` is checked in the handler, so a keeper
whose bond has been slashed below the minimum stops being able to book
yield at all.

instructions.name: bond_keeper
docs: Post or increase a $LODZ bond. Creates the caller's `Keeper` record on
first use.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Created on first bond. The second of exactly two `init_if_needed`
accounts in the program. No `has_one` here: on the creating call the
account is still zeroed, and the PDA seed already binds it to the
signer.

instructions.name: claim_redemption
docs: Pay out a ticket whose `claimable_at` has passed. Refuses before it.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit a registered BTC representation into a stope and receive
shares. Creates the caller's `Miner` position on first use.

accounts.name: miner
docs: Created on first deposit into this stope. This is one of exactly two
`init_if_needed` accounts in the program.

instructions.name: initialize_bond_vault
docs: Create `["bond_vault"]`, the $LODZ token account keeper bonds are held
in. Split from `initialize_vault` because `init` on a token account is
stack-expensive.

instructions.name: initialize_vault
docs: Create the global config PDA. The vault starts paused: no stope and no
adit exist yet, and a deposit against that state would be accepted
against nothing.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: $LODZ destination for slashed keeper bonds. Recorded now so
`slash_keeper` cannot be pointed at an arbitrary account later.

instructions.name: open_stope
docs: Open one of the three stopes together with its redemption queue.
`risk_profile` must be the canonical profile for `stope_id`
(0 conservative, 1 balanced, 2 aggressive); the program rejects any
other pairing so the id is a reliable key off-chain.

accounts.name: orecart_queue
docs: The stope and its queue are created together: a stope that can take
deposits before its redemption queue exists is a stope you can get into
and not out of.

instructions.name: pause_vault
docs: Halt deposits, accrual, redemption requests and rebalances.
`claim_redemption` keeps running.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Nominate the next authority. Takes effect only once it signs
`accept_authority`.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: `accept_authority` before it takes effect.

instructions.name: register_adit
docs: Register a BTC representation and create its custody account.
This is where the disclosure is fixed: the custody kind, the headlamp
risk tier, and the exact ratio at which this token is counted against
the internal accounting unit. A mint with no adit cannot be deposited.

instructions.name: register_seam
docs: Register a yield source against a stope.
An emissions seam must declare a future `emission_ends_at` and the mint
the emission is paid in. A sustainable seam must leave both unset. The
seam's risk tier and the stope's resulting emissions exposure are both
checked against the stope's risk profile.

accounts.name: adit
docs: A seam can only deploy an asset LODZ actually accepts. Requiring the
adit here is what keeps the registry a connected graph rather than two
lists that happen to mention the same mint.

instructions.name: request_redemption
docs: Burn shares and issue an Orecart ticket.
`ticket_index` must equal the caller's current `Miner::ticket_count`;
it is the third PDA seed of the ticket. The fee and the wait are
computed and frozen onto the ticket here.

accounts.name: adit
docs: The asset this ticket will pay out in. It does not have to be the asset
the depositor put in: the vault keeps its books in internal accounting
units, so any registered adit can settle a ticket, subject to that
asset's custody account holding enough at claim time.

instructions.name: slash_keeper
docs: Take a keeper's bond. Authority only; the taken amount moves to the
treasury recorded at initialization, and the keeper deactivates
automatically if the slash drops it below the minimum bond.

accounts.name: keeper_authority
docs: record's own `authority` field is compared against it below.

instructions.name: unbond_keeper
docs: Withdraw bond, no earlier than `keeper_unbond_cooldown_sec` after the
keeper's last rebalance.

instructions.name: unpause_vault
docs: Resume.

instructions.name: update_seam_allocation
docs: Move a seam's allocation. Requires an active bonded keeper, and
re-checks the stope's 100 % ceiling and its emissions ceiling.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the vault authority.

errors.name: NoPendingAuthority
errors.msg: No authority transfer is pending.

errors.name: NotPendingAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the pending authority.

errors.name: VaultPaused
errors.msg: The vault is paused.

errors.name: VaultNotPaused
errors.msg: The vault is not paused.

errors.name: StopePaused
errors.msg: This stope is paused.

errors.name: AditPaused
errors.msg: This adit is paused.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: DivisionByZero
errors.msg: Division by zero.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: InvalidFeeBps
errors.msg: Fee exceeds the hard cap enforced by the program.

errors.name: InvalidDelay
errors.msg: Redemption delay is outside the bounds enforced by the program.

errors.name: InvalidQueueDrain
errors.msg: Queue drain rate must be greater than zero.

errors.name: InvalidMinKeeperBond
errors.msg: Minimum keeper bond must be greater than zero.

errors.name: InvalidConversionRatio
errors.msg: Conversion ratio numerator and denominator must both be non-zero.

errors.name: InvalidDecimals
errors.msg: Mint decimals exceed the supported range.

errors.name: InvalidLabel
errors.msg: Label is empty or not NUL-padded ASCII.

errors.name: InvalidVenueName
errors.msg: Venue name is empty or not NUL-padded ASCII.

errors.name: InvalidRiskTier
errors.msg: Risk tier is outside the 1..=5 headlamp range.

errors.name: InvalidStopeId
errors.msg: Stope id must be 0 (conservative), 1 (balanced) or 2 (aggressive).

errors.name: RiskProfileMismatch
errors.msg: Risk profile does not match the canonical profile for this stope id.

errors.name: RiskTierExceedsStopeProfile
errors.msg: This seam's risk tier is above what this stope's risk profile permits.

errors.name: NoSharesOutstanding
errors.msg: The stope holds no shares, so there is nothing to distribute yield to.

errors.name: InvalidAllocationBps
errors.msg: Allocation basis points exceed 10000.

errors.name: AllocationExceeded
errors.msg: Total seam allocation for this stope would exceed 10000 basis points.

errors.name: EmissionEndMissing
errors.msg: Emissions-backed seams must declare a future emission_ends_at.

errors.name: EmissionEndInPast
errors.msg: emission_ends_at is in the past.

errors.name: EmissionFieldsOnSustainableSeam
errors.msg: A sustainable seam must leave emission_ends_at and emission_mint unset.

errors.name: EmissionMintMissing
errors.msg: Emissions-backed seams must name the mint the emission is paid in.

errors.name: EmissionEnded
errors.msg: This seam's emission window has ended; it can no longer accrue yield.

errors.name: EmissionsAllocationExceeded
errors.msg: Emissions allocation would exceed what this stope's risk profile permits.

errors.name: SeamInactive
errors.msg: The seam is not active.

errors.name: SeamStopeMismatch
errors.msg: The seam does not belong to the supplied stope.

errors.name: SeamAssetMismatch
errors.msg: The seam's asset mint does not match the supplied adit.

errors.name: AditMintMismatch
errors.msg: The adit does not accept this mint.

errors.name: AditVaultMismatch
errors.msg: The supplied vault is not the vault recorded on this adit.

errors.name: DepositCapExceeded
errors.msg: Deposit would exceed this adit's cap.

errors.name: DepositBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Deposit is too small to credit a single accounting unit.

errors.name: TokenProgramMismatch
errors.msg: The token program does not match the one pinned at registration.

errors.name: InsufficientShares
errors.msg: Requested shares exceed the miner's balance.

errors.name: TicketIndexMismatch
errors.msg: Ticket index does not match the miner's next ticket index.

errors.name: TicketAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This ticket has already been claimed.

errors.name: RedemptionNotClaimable

errors.name: QueueStopeMismatch
errors.msg: The queue does not belong to the supplied stope.

errors.name: TicketStopeMismatch
errors.msg: The ticket does not belong to the supplied stope.

errors.name: ZeroPayout
errors.msg: Redemption resolves to a zero payout after fees.

errors.name: InsufficientVaultLiquidity
errors.msg: The adit vault does not hold enough of this asset to settle the ticket.

errors.name: KeeperNotActive

errors.name: KeeperBondTooSmall

errors.name: KeeperAuthorityMismatch
errors.msg: The keeper record does not belong to the supplied authority.

errors.name: KeeperUnbondCooldown
errors.msg: The keeper unbond cooldown has not elapsed since its last rebalance.

errors.name: InsufficientBond
errors.msg: Requested amount exceeds the keeper's bonded balance.

errors.name: TreasuryMismatch
errors.msg: The supplied treasury does not match the one recorded in the config.

types.name: Adit
docs: A registered BTC representation and its custody vault.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: The SPL Token or Token-2022 mint accepted here.

fields.name: token_program
docs: Token program that owns `asset_mint`, pinned at registration.
A BTC representation may be a classic SPL Token mint or a Token-2022
mint. Every transfer on the deposit and payout paths re-checks the
supplied token program against this field, which is what makes it
impossible to route a Token-2022 mint through the classic program (the
`AccountOwnedByWrongProgram` failure in
new_project_guide/references/solana/anchor-lessons.md).

fields.name: vault
docs: `["adit_vault", asset_mint]` -- the program-owned custody token
account for this asset, whose authority is the `VaultConfig` PDA.

fields.name: conversion_num
docs: Conversion into internal accounting units:
`normalized = floor(amount * conversion_num / conversion_den)`.
Folds two things together, both fixed by the authority at registration:
the decimal difference between `decimals` and the internal 8-decimal
unit, and the asset's declared ratio to one BTC. A representation that
is not 1:1 with BTC is expressed here rather than being quietly counted
as if it were.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Hard cap on `total_deposited`, in the asset's native units. Zero means
no cap.

fields.name: total_deposited
docs: Native units currently custodied for this asset.

fields.name: total_normalized
docs: Internal accounting units credited against this asset over its
lifetime. Never decreases; `total_deposited` does.

fields.name: label
docs: Short NUL-padded ASCII label, e.g. `zBTC`. For indexers and logs; the
mint is the identity.

fields.name: custody_kind
docs: What the depositor is actually exposed to. See [`CustodyKind`]: every
variant is a token on Solana standing in for bitcoin held elsewhere,
never bitcoin on the Bitcoin network itself.

fields.name: risk_tier
docs: Headlamp tier, 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals of `asset_mint`, cached so the payout path can pass them to
`transfer_checked` without deserializing the mint twice.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new deposits through this adit. Redemptions of assets already
custodied here continue to settle.

types.name: CustodyKind
docs: What kind of claim a deposited token actually is.
No variant here is bitcoin on the Bitcoin network. A deposit into LODZ is a
deposit of an SPL or Token-2022 token that stands in for bitcoin held
somewhere else, and the variant records which "somewhere else" the
depositor is exposed to.

fields.name: amount
docs: What the depositor actually transferred, in the asset's native units.

fields.name: normalized_amount
docs: What it was worth in internal accounting units.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Redemption fee in basis points. Bounded by `MAX_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: redemption_delay_sec
docs: Base wait stamped on every Orecart ticket.

fields.name: max_redemption_delay_sec
docs: Ceiling on base + congestion.

fields.name: queue_drain_per_day
docs: Internal accounting units the protocol commits to settling per day.

fields.name: min_keeper_bond
docs: Minimum $LODZ bond for a keeper to count as active.

fields.name: keeper_unbond_cooldown_sec
docs: How long after its last rebalance a keeper must wait to unbond.

types.name: Keeper
docs: A keeper's bond and its record.

fields.name: authority
docs: The keeper's signing key, and the second seed of this PDA.

fields.name: bonded_amount
docs: $LODZ currently bonded, held in `["bond_vault"]`.

fields.name: slashed_amount
docs: $LODZ taken by slashes over this keeper's lifetime.

fields.name: unbond_ready_at
docs: Earliest time this keeper may withdraw bond.
Recomputed as `last_rebalance_at + keeper_unbond_cooldown_sec` on every
rebalance, so a keeper cannot make a bad reallocation and withdraw its
bond before the consequences of it are visible.

fields.name: active
docs: True while `bonded_amount >= VaultConfig::min_keeper_bond`. Maintained
on every bond, unbond and slash.

fields.name: reason_code
docs: Free-form reason code recorded on-chain so a slash can be argued about
with a reference rather than from memory.

types.name: Miner
docs: A depositor's principal claim and their two separate yield balances.
The per-source split runs all the way down to here. A miner can read how
much of their own accrued yield came from something a counterparty is
paying versus from an emission schedule with an end date, which is the
number that decides whether the position is worth keeping.

fields.name: ticket_count
docs: Next Orecart ticket index for this position. Ticket PDAs are
`["orecart", owner, ticket_index(u32 LE)]`, so this is the counter the
client must read before building a redemption transaction.

fields.name: shares
docs: Principal claim on the stope, in shares. One share is one internal
accounting unit of principal at the time it was deposited.

fields.name: deposited
docs: Lifetime internal units deposited.

fields.name: withdrawn
docs: Lifetime internal units paid out through claimed tickets.

fields.name: pending_redemption
docs: Internal units sitting in this miner's queued, unclaimed tickets.
Shares are burned at request time, not at claim time, so this is not a
reservation against `shares` -- it is principal that has already left
the share pool and is waiting out its delay. A miner in the queue stops
earning yield the moment they queue, which is the honest reading of a
redemption request.

fields.name: accrued_sustainable
docs: Settled sustainable yield, in internal accounting units.

fields.name: accrued_emissions
docs: Settled emissions yield, in internal accounting units.

fields.name: index_snapshot_sustainable
docs: Stope index values at the last settlement of this position.

types.name: Orecart
docs: One redemption ticket. Immutable after issue except for its claim fields.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: Asset this ticket pays out in, fixed at request time.

fields.name: ticket_index
docs: Index within the owner's tickets. Part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee rate captured at request time, so a later fee change by the
authority cannot be applied retroactively to a ticket already in the
queue.

fields.name: shares_burned
docs: Shares burned to open this ticket. They are gone from the stope's share
pool already; this field is the record, not a reservation.

fields.name: normalized_amount
docs: Principal owed, in internal accounting units, before the fee.

fields.name: fee_normalized
docs: Fee, in internal accounting units.

fields.name: gross_amount
docs: `normalized_amount` converted into the asset's native units.

fields.name: fee_amount
docs: Fee in native units: `gross_amount - payout_amount`.

fields.name: payout_amount
docs: What `claim_redemption` transfers, in native units.

fields.name: queue_position
docs: Position in the stope's issue order.

fields.name: claimable_at
docs: The chain-enforced gate. `claim_redemption` requires
`Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp >= claimable_at`.

types.name: OrecartQueue
docs: Per-stope queue aggregate.

fields.name: head
docs: Tickets claimed so far. Because tickets settle independently this is a
count, not a pointer into an ordered list.

fields.name: tail
docs: Tickets issued so far. The next ticket's `queue_position`.

fields.name: pending_tickets
docs: `tail - head`, maintained rather than derived so a reader sees it in
one field.

fields.name: total_pending
docs: Internal units awaiting claim. This is the backlog the congestion term
in `math::queue_delay_sec` is computed against.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Internal units paid out over the queue's lifetime.

fields.name: total_fees
docs: Internal units retained as redemption fees.

fields.name: waited_sec
docs: How long the depositor actually waited, in seconds.

fields.name: queue_pending_ahead
docs: Backlog standing in front of this ticket when it was issued.

fields.name: claimable_at
docs: The enforced gate, not an estimate.

fields.name: label
docs: NUL-padded ASCII, e.g. `zBTC`.

fields.name: custody_kind
docs: What the depositor is exposed to. None of the variants is native
bitcoin.

fields.name: risk_tier
docs: Headlamp tier, 1..=5.

fields.name: conversion_num
docs: `normalized = floor(amount * conversion_num / conversion_den)`.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Cap on native units custodied here. Zero means uncapped.

fields.name: venue
docs: NUL-padded ASCII venue name.

fields.name: venue_program
docs: Venue program, or `Pubkey::default()` when the venue is not a Solana
program.

fields.name: emission_ends_at
docs: Required non-zero and in the future for `YieldKind::Emissions`,
required zero for `YieldKind::Sustainable`.

fields.name: emission_mint
docs: Required set for `YieldKind::Emissions`, required default for
`YieldKind::Sustainable`.

types.name: RiskProfile
docs: Risk appetite of a stope. Fixed to the stope id: 0 conservative,
1 balanced, 2 aggressive.

types.name: Seam
docs: A registered yield source and its allocation within one stope.

fields.name: allocation_bps
docs: Share of the owning stope's capital routed here, in basis points.

fields.name: stope_id
docs: Stope this seam belongs to. A seam serves exactly one stope, so a
stope's emissions exposure is the sum over its own seams and nothing
else.

fields.name: yield_kind
docs: Sustainable or emissions. Immutable after registration: changing it
would silently rewrite the meaning of `realized_yield` already booked
under the old kind.

fields.name: risk_tier
docs: Headlamp tier, 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest). Bounded by the owning
stope's `RiskProfile::max_risk_tier`.

fields.name: active
docs: Inactive seams cannot accrue and cannot hold an allocation.

fields.name: venue
docs: NUL-padded ASCII venue name, e.g. `kyros-lend`.

fields.name: venue_program
docs: On-chain program of the venue, when it has one. `Pubkey::default()`
for a venue that is not a Solana program.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: Mint of the asset deployed into this seam.

fields.name: emission_mint
docs: For an emissions seam, the mint the emission is paid in. Required to be
set for `YieldKind::Emissions` and required to be
`Pubkey::default()` for `YieldKind::Sustainable`.

fields.name: realized_yield
docs: Lifetime realized yield from this seam, in internal accounting units.
One kind only, because the seam is one kind only.

fields.name: emission_ends_at
docs: Unix timestamp at which this seam's emission schedule ends.
Required to be non-zero and in the future for an emissions seam, and
required to be zero for a sustainable one. `accrue_yield` refuses an
emissions accrual once the chain clock has passed it, so a seam cannot
keep reporting yield from a schedule that has run out.

fields.name: stope_allocated_bps
docs: Stope totals after the change, so a reader never has to re-sum the
seam accounts to see the resulting exposure.

fields.name: emission_ends_at
docs: Zero for a sustainable seam; the end of the schedule for an emissions
seam, which the program required to be in the future at registration.

fields.name: stope_emissions_bps
docs: Stope-wide emissions share after this seam was added.

types.name: Stope
docs: One risk-profiled vault: its shares, its principal, and two separate yield
accumulators.
There is no combined `total_yield` field anywhere in this struct, and that
is deliberate. Sustainable and emissions yield are accumulated, indexed and
reported apart from each other all the way down to the individual miner,
because a single blended number cannot answer the only question that
matters about a BTC yield product: how much of this survives when the
emission schedule ends.

fields.name: risk_profile
docs: Fixed to `stope_id` by `RiskProfile::from_id`.

fields.name: allocated_bps
docs: Sum of `allocation_bps` over this stope's active seams. Never above

fields.name: emissions_bps
docs: The part of `allocated_bps` that sits on seams whose yield kind is
[`YieldKind::Emissions`]. Capped by
`RiskProfile::max_emissions_bps`.
This is the headline honesty number for the stope, maintained
incrementally on every allocation change so a reader never has to sum
the seam accounts to learn it.

fields.name: yield_index_sustainable
docs: Per-share accumulator for sustainable yield, scaled by
`YIELD_INDEX_SCALE`.

fields.name: yield_index_emissions
docs: Per-share accumulator for emissions yield, scaled by
`YIELD_INDEX_SCALE`.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding principal claims. A share is one internal accounting unit
of principal.

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: Principal actually held against those claims. Equal to `total_shares`
while no loss has been recorded; the redemption path divides by
`total_shares` rather than assuming parity, so a future loss-recording
instruction does not require re-deriving every payout formula.

fields.name: pending_redemption
docs: Internal units reserved by queued Orecart tickets and not yet paid out.

fields.name: total_redeemed
docs: Internal units paid out over this stope's lifetime.

fields.name: realized_sustainable
docs: Lifetime realized sustainable yield, in internal accounting units.

fields.name: realized_emissions
docs: Lifetime realized emissions yield, in internal accounting units.

types.name: TicketStatus
docs: Lifecycle of an Orecart redemption ticket.

types.name: VaultConfig
docs: Global protocol configuration and the signing authority for every
program-owned token account.
This PDA is also the token authority of `["bond_vault"]` and of every
`["adit_vault", asset_mint]`, so its bump is read on the payout path and is
stored rather than recomputed.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin key. Checked with `has_one = authority` on every admin-only
instruction.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed next authority. `Pubkey::default()` when no handover is
pending. Two-step handover exists so a typo in an authority transfer
cannot brick the protocol.

fields.name: lodz_mint
docs: $LODZ mint. Keeper bonds are denominated in it.

fields.name: lodz_token_program
docs: Token program that owns `lodz_mint`, pinned at initialization. Deposits
pin their own token program per Adit; this one covers bond and slash.

fields.name: treasury
docs: $LODZ token account that receives slashed keeper bonds.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Redemption fee, in basis points, charged on the gross payout of an
Orecart ticket. Capped by `MAX_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: redemption_delay_sec
docs: Base wait stamped on every ticket, before queue congestion.

fields.name: max_redemption_delay_sec
docs: Ceiling applied to `base + congestion`. A ticket is never stamped with
a `claimable_at` further out than this.

fields.name: queue_drain_per_day
docs: Internal accounting units the protocol commits to being able to settle
per day. Drives the congestion term in `math::queue_delay_sec`.

fields.name: min_keeper_bond
docs: Minimum bond for a keeper to count as active.

fields.name: keeper_unbond_cooldown_sec
docs: A keeper may not withdraw bond until this many seconds have passed
since its last rebalance. Evidence that a rebalance was bad surfaces
after the fact, so the cooldown is anchored to the last action rather
than to the unbond request.

fields.name: total_normalized_deposits
docs: Sum of live deposits across every stope, in internal accounting units.

fields.name: paused
docs: Global circuit breaker. Blocks deposits, accrual, redemption requests
and rebalances. It deliberately does **not** block `claim_redemption`:
a ticket whose delay has already elapsed is a settled debt, and a pause
switch that can strand it is a rug with extra steps.

fields.name: yield_kind
docs: The whole point of this event. Never summed with the other kind.

fields.name: stope_realized_sustainable
docs: Stope lifetime totals after this accrual, kept apart.

fields.name: emission_ends_at
docs: Zero for a sustainable seam. For an emissions seam this is when the
number above stops arriving.

types.name: YieldKind
docs: How a seam produces its yield.
This split is the product. A protocol that reports one blended APY cannot
tell a depositor whether the number survives next quarter, so the two are
never summed into a single field anywhere in this program: separate
accumulators on the [`Stope`], separate accumulators on the [`Miner`], and
a `yield_kind` on every `YieldAccrued` event.
